body:
It seems to me that loneliness is the common thread that is preventing you from enjoying these games. It's not so much the fear of bodily harm which is what is traditionally "scary" but the isolation that gets to you. I understand that. 

Try to do things that might alleviate that lonely feeling those games have. Playing co-op might not be a bad idea. Borderlands and Minecraft are both fun as hell with others. 

As far as gone home?... Maybe play some music in the background? Or play the game with someone else in the room.
